versions.changelog: 链接口径统一：payment_link 改为官方详情页，购买动作在详情页完成，包内不出现支付直链
核心原理重构为双路线结构（A 直连互@ / B Gateway 路由）；移除旧转化页；获取链接统一为官方 jinengpu 渠道；兼容清单统一为 8 框架（含 CherryStudio 修正）；README 收敛为摘要页并新增 128 字符摘要
Add MIT LICENSE to repository root; refresh README with install instructions (ClawHub + git clone); repository housekeeping. No changes to skill logic.

- Initial release of feishu-multi-agent-chat for Feishu group collaboration.
- Enables multiple AI Agents to communicate via mutual @ mentions in group chats using text format.
- Covers full workflow: group creation, Bot setup, Bot invitation, open_id retrieval, message formatting, error prevention, and troubleshooting.
- Provides guidance on permissions, open_id isolation, and framework compatibility (supports CherryClaw, WorkBuddy, OpenClaw, AutoClaw).
- Includes practical step-by-step instructions and common error handling for stable multi-agent operation.
